about.loading.description: In place of the server's about page while it loads.

about.failed.defaultMessage: The server's information could not be loaded.
about.failed.description: In place of the about page when the server's information could not be loaded, before Try again.

about.retry.description: The button after a sentence of the about page or a document's page that says something could not be loaded.

about.sign_in.description: The link after the line that says the moderated servers are shown to signed-in people. Read by visitors.

about.contact.description: The heading of the section of the about page that names the account and the email address that reach the server's operators.

about.rules.description: The heading of the server's rules on the about page.

about.rules.number.description: The number before a rule in the list of the server's rules on the about page.

about.documents.description: The heading of the section of the about page that leads to the terms of service and the privacy policy.

about.terms.description: The row of the about page that opens the terms of service.

about.privacy.description: The row of the about page that opens the privacy policy.

about.commerce.description: The row of the about page that opens the commerce disclosure of the supporter plans (in Japan, the disclosure under the Act on Specified Commercial Transactions).

about.domains.description: The heading of the list of the other servers this server limits or suspends, on the about page.

about.domains.signed_in.defaultMessage: Only people signed in to this server can see which servers it moderates.
about.domains.signed_in.description: In place of the list of moderated servers for a visitor, when the server shows it to signed-in people alone; Sign in follows it.

about.domains.loading.description: In place of the list of moderated servers while it loads.

about.domains.failed.defaultMessage: The servers could not be loaded.
about.domains.failed.description: In place of the list of moderated servers when it could not be loaded, before Try again.

about.domains.none.description: In place of the list of moderated servers when it is empty.

about.domains.kind.description: What this server did to another server, after its domain in the list of moderated servers: suspended (no federation at all) or limited (its posts kept off the public timelines).

about.reviews.description: The heading of the section of the about page that says what the server sends to an outside service to review before it accepts it.

about.reviews.lead.defaultMessage: Before accepting them, this server sends these to an outside service to review:
about.reviews.lead.description: The sentence over the list of what the server sends to an external review, on the about page.

about.reviews.hook.defaultMessage: {hook, select, inbound_status {Posts from other servers} inbound_follow {Follows from other servers} signup_check {Sign-ups} media_check {Uploaded media} local_status {Posts on this server} inbound_actor {Profiles from other servers} local_profile {Profiles on this server} other {Other content}}
about.reviews.hook.description: An item of the list of what the server sends to an external review, on the about page.

about.reviews.new_accounts.defaultMessage: {what} from accounts up to {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} old
about.reviews.new_accounts.description: An item of the list of what the server sends to an external review, when only the content of new accounts is sent; {what} is the item's name (Posts on this server).

about.reviews.unfollowed_direct.defaultMessage: {what}, including direct messages from people nobody here follows
about.reviews.unfollowed_direct.description: An item of the list of what the server sends to an external review: posts from other servers, including their direct messages from people no account of this server follows; {what} is the item's name.

about.auto_delete.description: The heading of the section of the about page that says how long the server keeps posts.

about.auto_delete.max.defaultMessage: Posts are deleted {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after they are posted.
about.auto_delete.max.description: The most days the server keeps a post, on the about page.

about.auto_delete.keep.description: What people may keep past the most days, on the about page; {kinds} is a list of the kinds (pinned posts, posts you bookmarked), joined as the language joins a list.

about.auto_delete.pinned.description: A kind of post people may keep from the automatic deletion, in the list of about.auto_delete.keep.

about.auto_delete.pins.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {your most recently pinned post} other {your # most recently pinned posts}}
about.auto_delete.pins.description: A kind of post people may keep from the automatic deletion when only the latest pins keep posts, in the list of about.auto_delete.keep.

about.auto_delete.bookmarked.description: A kind of post people may keep from the automatic deletion, in the list of about.auto_delete.keep.

about.auto_delete.favourited.description: A kind of post people may keep from the automatic deletion, in the list of about.auto_delete.keep.

about.auto_delete.media.description: A kind of post people may keep from the automatic deletion, in the list of about.auto_delete.keep.

about.auto_delete.polls.description: A kind of post people may keep from the automatic deletion, in the list of about.auto_delete.keep.

about.auto_delete.articles.description: A kind of post people may keep from the automatic deletion, in the list of about.auto_delete.keep.

about.auto_delete.visibilities.defaultMessage: posts of the visibilities you choose
about.auto_delete.visibilities.description: A kind of post people may keep from the automatic deletion, in the list of about.auto_delete.keep.

about.auto_delete.thresholds.defaultMessage: posts with enough boosts or favourites
about.auto_delete.thresholds.description: A kind of post people may keep from the automatic deletion, in the list of about.auto_delete.keep.

about.crawlers.description: The heading of the section of the about page on what the server states to search engines and AI crawlers.

about.crawlers.search.defaultMessage: {value, select, allow {Search engines may index the public posts and profiles of people who allow it.} other {Search engines are asked not to index this server.}}
about.crawlers.search.description: What the server states to search engines, on the about page.

about.crawlers.ai.defaultMessage: {value, select, allow {AI crawlers are asked nothing.} deny_training {AI crawlers are asked not to train on its pages.} other {AI crawlers are asked not to train on its pages or use them.}}
about.crawlers.ai.description: What the server states to AI crawlers, on the about page, after about.crawlers.search.

about.crawlers.how.defaultMessage: The statement is in this server's robots.txt, in the tags and headers of its pages, and in its TDMRep file. It covers the pages of this server alone: other servers make their own, and media files carry only the server's.
about.crawlers.how.description: How the server makes its statement to search engines and AI crawlers and how far it reaches, in the section of the about page on them, after what it states.

about.crawlers.legal.defaultMessage: What such a statement means in law depends on the country, and many operators follow such statements voluntarily. This text is not legal advice.
about.crawlers.legal.description: The legal note at the end of the section of the about page on what the server states to search engines and AI crawlers. It names no country's law.

about.crawler.description: The title of the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler, which the row of the about page opens.

about.crawlers.link_cards.defaultMessage: As the crawler my-linkcard, this server also fetches the pages that posts link to, to show cards of them.
about.crawlers.link_cards.description: After what the server states to search engines and AI crawlers, in the section of the about page on them: that the server fetches linked pages for cards, as its own crawler.

about.crawlers.crawler.defaultMessage: What that crawler does, and how a website refuses it
about.crawlers.crawler.description: The row of the about page that opens the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.intro.defaultMessage: When a post on this server links to a web page, the server fetches that page to show a card with its title, description, and image. This page is for the people who run those websites: what the requests are, and how to refuse them.
about.crawler.intro.description: Opening paragraph of the page about the link card crawler. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.state.obeys.defaultMessage: On this server, the crawler is on and it obeys robots.txt.
about.crawler.state.obeys.description: What the crawler does on this server, in its usual settings: at the top of the page about the crawler. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.state.ignores.defaultMessage: On this server, the crawler is on and, by its administrators' choice, does not read robots.txt. A website cannot refuse it here with robots.txt. The directives of a page still apply, and the administrators can stop fetching from a domain.
about.crawler.state.ignores.description: What the crawler does on a server whose setting link_cards_ignore_robots_txt is on: at the top of the page about the crawler. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.state.off.defaultMessage: On this server, link cards are off, so the crawler fetches nothing now. The rest of this page says what it does while they are on.
about.crawler.state.off.description: What the crawler does on a server whose setting link_cards is off: at the top of the page about the crawler. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.identity.title.description: Heading of the section with the User-Agent of the link card crawler. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.identity.user_agent.description: Sentence before the User-Agent of the crawler, shown as code. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.identity.token.defaultMessage: The address in it is this server. In robots.txt and in the directives of a page, the crawler is named my-linkcard.
about.crawler.identity.token.description: Explains the User-Agent of the crawler and the name it goes by. my-linkcard is a literal name: do not translate it. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.identity.others.defaultMessage: This server makes its other requests, such as those of federation, under the name my/, and this page does not cover them. Two of them can follow a card: it may fetch the card's image again as my/ to show it to readers, and it looks up the account that a page names in fediverse:creator.
about.crawler.identity.others.description: Other requests of the server that a site operator can see, under the server's general User-Agent. my/ and fediverse:creator are literal: do not translate them. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.trigger.title.description: Heading of the section that says what makes the crawler fetch a URL. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.trigger.post.defaultMessage: A post that links to the URL. The server makes a card from the first link in the body of a post, whatever the post's visibility, and fetches the page if it has no recent card of it.
about.crawler.trigger.post.description: What makes the crawler fetch a URL. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.trigger.remote.defaultMessage: That includes posts that arrive from other servers, not only those written here, so a request does not mean that someone here read your page.
about.crawler.trigger.remote.description: That posts federated from other servers cause fetches too. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.fetches.title.description: Heading of the section that lists what the crawler requests from a website. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.fetches.page.defaultMessage: The page. It reads only the head of the page, follows up to 5 redirects, and runs nothing in it.
about.crawler.fetches.page.description: What the crawler fetches: the linked page. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.fetches.image.defaultMessage: One image, the one that the head of the page names.
about.crawler.fetches.image.description: What the crawler fetches: the page's image. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.fetches.robots.defaultMessage: robots.txt of the origin of the page, of each address it redirects to, and of the image, before it requests them.
about.crawler.fetches.robots.description: What the crawler fetches: robots.txt. Shown only while the server reads it. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.fetches.nothing_else.defaultMessage: It follows no links, so it does not crawl the rest of your site.
about.crawler.fetches.nothing_else.description: That the crawler does not crawl a whole website. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.sends.title.description: Heading of the section that says what the crawler's requests carry. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.sends.headers.defaultMessage: The User-Agent above, the kinds of content it accepts, and for a page, this server's default language in Accept-Language.
about.crawler.sends.headers.description: What the crawler's requests carry. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.sends.not.defaultMessage: It sends no cookies and no Referer, and nothing tells you which account or post linked the page.
about.crawler.sends.not.description: What the crawler's requests do not carry. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.frequency.title.description: Heading of the section that says how often the crawler requests a URL. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.frequency.once.defaultMessage: Each URL is fetched once, and the posts that link to it share its card. A post fetches it again only if the last fetch was 14 days ago or more; the server does not go back over its cards by itself.
about.crawler.frequency.once.description: How often the crawler requests a page. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.frequency.failure.defaultMessage: A URL that fails is not requested again for 24 hours.
about.crawler.frequency.failure.description: That the crawler remembers failures. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.frequency.host.defaultMessage: It makes one request at a time to a host, with at least a second between them. Only the redirects of a request and the robots.txt it needs come with it.
about.crawler.frequency.host.description: The limit of the crawler per host. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.frequency.throttled.defaultMessage: When a host answers 429 or 503, the crawler requests nothing from it for the time in Retry-After, at most an hour, or for a minute without one. After 5 such answers for a URL within 24 hours, it counts the URL as failed.
about.crawler.frequency.throttled.description: That the crawler stops for a host that asks it to. 429, 503 and Retry-After are literal. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.frequency.robots.defaultMessage: robots.txt is read about once a day per origin (scheme, host, and port). When it cannot be read (429, 5xx, or a network failure), the crawler fetches nothing from the origin and tries again an hour later.
about.crawler.frequency.robots.description: How often the crawler reads robots.txt. Shown only while the server reads it. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.title.description: Heading of the section that says how a website refuses the crawler. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.robots.title.description: Heading (h3) of the part about refusing the crawler in robots.txt. robots.txt is literal. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.robots.intro.defaultMessage: To refuse every fetch from your site, add this to robots.txt:
about.crawler.opt_out.robots.intro.description: Sentence before the robots.txt example that refuses the crawler. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.robots.star.defaultMessage: Without a group of that name, the crawler follows the group for *. Allow, Disallow, *, and $ are read, as RFC 9309 says, so you can also refuse only some paths.
about.crawler.opt_out.robots.star.description: How the crawler reads robots.txt. Allow, Disallow, *, $ and RFC 9309 are literal. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.robots.timing.defaultMessage: The crawler obeys a new rule within a day. A card it already has goes when a post fetches its URL again, or sooner if you ask the administrators.
about.crawler.opt_out.robots.timing.description: When a change of robots.txt takes effect. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.robots.ignored.defaultMessage: This server does not read robots.txt, so this rule has no effect here. It applies on servers that obey it.
about.crawler.opt_out.robots.ignored.description: Under the robots.txt part, on a server whose setting link_cards_ignore_robots_txt is on. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.title.defaultMessage: Limit the card: directives of a page
about.crawler.opt_out.directives.title.description: Heading (h3) of the part about the page directives that change a card. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.intro.defaultMessage: A page can keep its description or its image out of the card. The crawler still requests the page, since it learns the directives from it. These apply whether or not this server reads robots.txt:
about.crawler.opt_out.directives.intro.description: Sentence before the table of page directives. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.caption.defaultMessage: What each directive changes in a card
about.crawler.opt_out.directives.caption.description: The name, for assistive technology, of the table of what each directive of a page changes in a card, on the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.directi.description: Column header: a page directive. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.effect.description: Column header: what the directive does to the card. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.nosnipp.description: What the directives nosnippet and max-snippet:0 do to a card. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.noimage.defaultMessage: No image, and the image is not requested.
about.crawler.opt_out.directives.noimage.description: What the directives noimageindex and max-image-preview:none do to a card. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.noindex.defaultMessage: No change. These ask to stay out of search results, and a card is not a search result: it appears only because someone posted the link, and many pages that stay out of search are meant to be shared. To refuse, use robots.txt.
about.crawler.opt_out.directives.noindex.description: What the directives noindex and none do to a card, with the reason in plain words. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.noindex.defaultMessage: No change. These ask to stay out of search results, and a card is not a search result: it appears only because someone posted the link, and many pages that stay out of search are meant to be shared. To refuse on this server, ask its administrators.
about.crawler.opt_out.directives.noindex.description: What the directives noindex and none do to a card, on a server that does not read robots.txt. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.rest.defaultMessage: The title, the site name, and the author stay under every directive.
about.crawler.opt_out.directives.rest.description: What no page directive removes from a card. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.where.defaultMessage: Write them in a meta tag named robots or my-linkcard in the head of the page, or in an X-Robots-Tag header:
about.crawler.opt_out.directives.where.description: Sentence before the examples of where a directive goes. robots, my-linkcard and X-Robots-Tag are literal. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.contact.title.description: Heading of the section with how to reach the operators of the server that runs the crawler. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.contact.intro.defaultMessage: The administrators can stop the crawler on a domain and its subdomains, or stop only its images. That takes effect at once, also on the cards the server already has, so ask them if you need a fetch to stop or a card to go.
about.crawler.contact.intro.description: That the operators of the server can stop the crawler per domain, and that a site operator can ask them. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.contact.none.description: In place of the contact details when the server has none. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.funding.description: The heading of the section of the about page with this month's funding meter and the way to the server's costs and income.

about.funding.page.description: The row of the about page that opens the page of the server's published costs and income.

about.support.description: The heading of the section of the about page that leads to the supporter plans, the tips and the commerce disclosure.

about.support.page.defaultMessage: {offer, select, both {Supporter plans and tips} plans {Supporter plans} other {Tip the server}}
about.support.page.description: The row of the about page that opens the supporters' page: its plans and tips, its plans, or its tips alone.

about.support.list.description: The line under the row that opens the supporters' page, where the page lists the supporters too.

about.server.description: The heading of the section of the about page with the server's status page, source code and version, and the name of its list of facts.

about.server.status.description: A term of the server's facts on the about page: the address of its status page, on a service apart from the server.

about.server.source.description: A term of the server's facts on the about page: where to get the source code of the software it runs.

about.server.version.description: A term of the server's facts on the about page: the version of the software it runs.

about.document.title.defaultMessage: {kind, select, terms {Terms of service} privacy_policy {Privacy policy} other {Commerce disclosure}}
about.document.title.description: The title of the page of a document of the server, and the document's title.

about.document.revised.description: Under the title of a document of the server: the day of its last revision, as the reader's language writes a date.

about.document.loading.description: In place of a document of the server while it loads.

about.document.failed.defaultMessage: The document could not be loaded.
about.document.failed.description: In place of a document of the server when it could not be loaded, before Try again.

about.document.unpublished.defaultMessage: {kind, select, terms {This server has not published terms of service.} privacy_policy {This server has not published a privacy policy.} other {This server has not published a commerce disclosure.}}
about.document.unpublished.description: The page of a document the server has not published; a link to the about page follows.

about.back.description: The way back to the server's about page: the button at the start of a document's page and of the page on search engines and AI, and the link after the sentence that says the server has not published a document.
